places-los-rumies-abric-de-gontran.story: From Calasparra it runs 310 km to Calasparra; allow about 5 h 21 of riding. The stops in between: Abrigo Grande de minateda, Cueva del Peliciego, Olula and Abric de Gontrán. The line favours views over speed.
